name: neural-network-playground
description: Interactive neural network: the beach decision, its weights, the dot product, the sigmoid and the matrix form of a layer

paragraphs: Interactive companion to the Deep Learning class (neural networks: from one neuron to a network, and its notation) of an introductory machine-learning course.

The network answers one question: should I go to the beach this afternoon? Eight inputs (sunshine, temperature, sea temperature, wind, rain forecast, weekend or holiday, late afternoon, towel color), a hidden layer of two neurons (will it be nice? and will it be quiet?) and one output neuron that goes only when the afternoon is nice and quiet.

of the slides, and see every neuron light up. Point at any part of the drawing to see its name in the notation of the course and its value: a line is a weight w^[l]{j,k}, the Σ half of a neuron its weighted sum z, the σ half its activation a, the small badge its bias b. The lines can show the weights or the signals w × x. A plot shows what happens to both hidden neurons and to the answer when only one input changes.
